import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long sn = 10000000, sd = 1;
        for (int den = 1; den <= n; ++den) {
            double ap = (double) x * den / (double) y;
            long num = (long) ap;
            if (ap - (double) num > 0.5) num++;
            long left = Math.abs(x * sd - sn * y) * den;
            long right = Math.abs(x * den - num * y) * sd;
            if (left > right) {
                sn = num;
                sd = den;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(sn + "/" + sd);
    }
}
